items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: We had Hibler on our -- singing

ctx.x: Yeah, and I used to go to the man and say why don't you get some music in here so he says well, who should I get and I said get ahold of Johnny Hodges, so I went down and saw Johnny that night and I said go up to the Apollo bar and talk to the man about business. All right.

Johnny went up, the man hired Johnny and Johnny hired me as a manager and Junior Ragland Ragland was there and I wonder who else was there, anyway, he was one of the spots and Billy Eckstine was the other spot. We had Hibler on our -- singing,
and we opened and you couldn't get in there, man, they talked about Johnny Hodges is at the Apollo bar.
